reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is tiered model routing, subagent orchestration, failure escalation, and guarded execution across planning and implementation tasks.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 按任务难度在强弱模型间路由步骤，并提供子代理调度、审查、故障升级和高影响操作拦截。
summaries.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness steps between strong and cheap model tiers while providing subagent dispatch, review, failure escalation, and high-impact action gating.

capabilities: Routes model steps between configured strong and cheap provider/model tiers
Dispatches bounded subagents with configurable tier, tool filters, depth limits, and background execution
Escalates sessions after repeated failures or when high-impact tool patterns are detected
Persists tier and provider/model configuration in a settings namespace
